about.description: AKS is the base ERC-20 share token for Aktionariat AG, the Swiss tokenization provider that operates the Aktionariat platform. Each AKS represents 1:1 ownership in one common share of Aktionariat AG under Swiss law (CHE-453.438.437). AKS is the 'naked' share token in Aktionariat's modular share-token design: it carries minimal on-chain functionality and is typically wrapped into DAKS (Draggable Aktionariat AG Shares) before being placed in active circulation. The DAKS wrapper adds drag-along clauses, voting/transfer features, and shareholder-agreement enforcement consistent with the underlying corporate governance terms.
